# Carelu

> Carelu is the front office of care — an AI intake and lead-response platform for ABA therapy and behavioral-health providers. When a family reaches out by phone, chat, web form, or text, Carelu answers instantly, completes the intake, gathers records, and verifies insurance eligibility — so providers admit more families with the same team, instead of losing them to slow follow-up or after-hours gaps.

Carelu is built specifically for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and behavioral-health organizations of every size, from single-site clinics to multi-site groups and enterprise providers. It is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and signs a BAA with every provider.

## What Carelu does

- **Answers every inbound family, 24/7** — across phone calls, live chat, web forms, and text. No missed calls, no after-hours voicemail, no lead sitting in an inbox overnight.
- **Completes intake end to end** — from first contact to admitted patient: greeting, scheduling, collecting demographics and documents, and verifying insurance eligibility up front.
- **Verifies insurance and benefits** before a human ever picks up, so staff spend time on the families most likely to start care.
- **Unifies every channel into one live queue** — phone, chat, forms, faxes, and EHR referrals land in a single, searchable place with live status on each family.
- **Frees your team for the human work** — the calls and the trust only people can build. Carelu handles the rote front-office work around them.

## Who it is for

- ABA therapy providers (single-site, multi-site, and enterprise)
- Behavioral-health and autism-services organizations
- Home care, mental health, addiction treatment, and hospice intake teams

## The problem Carelu solves

ABA and behavioral-health providers lose a large share of new families to slow or after-hours intake — industry drop-off between first inquiry and first appointment commonly runs 40–85%. Families reach out to several providers at once; the first one to actually respond and complete intake wins the placement. Carelu makes sure that is always you, without adding front-desk headcount.

## Original research & tools

- [The Intake Gap (research report)](https://carelu.com/research/the-intake-gap): Carelu Research's Intake Data Report №1 — findings from 185,054 family conversations across 120 ABA provider organizations in 48 states (aggregated and de-identified). Key statistics: 48% of family conversations start outside business hours; median same-store demand grew 35% year over year; Georgia and North Carolina together account for 27% of national demand; 0 of 114 providers offer in-conversation appointment booking; 40% of captured website leads are job seekers, not families; 46% of families report Medicaid as their payer; 22% of families reach out before receiving a diagnosis; only 2% of providers run automated re-engagement. Citable with attribution: Carelu Research, "The Intake Gap" (2026).
- [Intake Leak Calculator](https://carelu.com/tools/intake-leak-calculator): Free interactive tool — enter monthly inquiries, monthly starts, and revenue per client to see how many families and how much revenue an intake funnel loses per year versus an 80% benchmark.

## Guides & resources

- [ABA waitlist management](https://carelu.com/resources/aba-waitlist-management): How to keep waitlisted families engaged, verified, and ready to start — with a free intake checklist.
- [The ABA client intake process](https://carelu.com/resources/aba-client-intake-process): Step-by-step intake from first contact to first session, with benchmarks for each step.
- [ABA intake forms](https://carelu.com/resources/aba-intake-forms): The seven sections every intake packet needs, plus a free printable form template.
- [ABA intake drop-off](https://carelu.com/resources/aba-intake-drop-off): Why 40–85% of families disappear between inquiry and first session, and how to fix each leak.
- [Free ABA intake checklist (PDF)](https://carelu.com/downloads/aba-intake-checklist.pdf): Printable checklist covering the full intake process.
- [Free ABA intake form template (PDF)](https://carelu.com/downloads/aba-intake-form-template.pdf): Printable intake packet template with all seven sections.
- [Pediatric referral contacts dataset](https://carelu.com/resources/pediatrician-referral-contacts): Free CSV dataset of 150,325 pediatricians and child-development professionals across all 50 U.S. states and Washington D.C. — names, titles, organizations, locations, 9,721 verified emails, and 149,475 phone numbers (direct lines where verified, practice lines otherwise, each labeled) — built on the federal NPI registry and enriched through dozens of provider sources, for building pediatrician referral relationships. Downloadable per state or combined. Each state has a browsable directory page at /resources/pediatrician-referral-contacts/<state> (e.g. /california, /texas, /new-york) with the contact table, role breakdown, and top cities and organizations.

## Payer guides (ABA coverage & prior authorization)

- [Payer directory](https://carelu.com/payers): All ABA payer guides — national commercial payers plus state-specific Medicaid and BCBS guides, updated on a rolling basis.

- [CareSource Georgia (Medicaid CMO) ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/caresource-georgia): How CareSource administers the GA Medicaid ABA benefit under MCD-MM-0212 (aligned to the DCH manual), with in-house PA and a 2026 reimbursement change.
- [Peach State Health Plan (GA Medicaid CMO) ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/peach-state-georgia): GA.CP.BH.504 — hour parameters, the 80%-attendance rule, and 0373T requirements.
- [Amerigroup Georgia (Medicaid CMO) ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/amerigroup-georgia): CG-BEH-02 adaptive behavioral treatment, aligned to the DCH manual.
- [Georgia Medicaid ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/georgia-medicaid): Coverage under EPSDT for members under 21, Katie Beckett access for higher-income families, separate assessment and treatment prior authorizations in 6-month increments, CMO landscape, codes and modifiers.
- [Aetna ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/aetna): ASD-only coverage under CPB 0554, precertification via form GR-69017-4 (eff. 1/1/2026), provider qualifications, telehealth codes.
- [Cigna ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/cigna): No prior auth on assessment codes; treatment authorization under EN0499; treatment-plan and session-note standards; all ABA codes covered via telehealth.
- [UnitedHealthcare / Optum ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/unitedhealthcare-optum): Two-step authorization via Provider Express, 4–6 month reviews, code clusters, 80% utilization threshold, telehealth attestation.
- [Anthem BCBS Georgia ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/anthem-bcbs-georgia): CG-BEH-02 criteria, billing and documentation rules, and how Ava's Law and MHPAEA parity affect Georgia coverage.
- [North Carolina Medicaid ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/north-carolina-medicaid): ABA as Research-Based Behavioral Health Treatment (RB-BHT) under Clinical Coverage Policy 8F — under 21, service authorization, 6-month treatment-plan reviews.
- [Indiana Medicaid (IHCP) ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/indiana-medicaid): Medically necessary ABA with prior auth on all services; 2026 shift to EPSDT-only and the under-21 limit; telehealth restrictions.
- [Virginia Medicaid (DMAS) ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/virginia-medicaid): EPSDT coverage under 21, prior authorization with per-code unit requests (eff. Oct 2025), diagnosis and FBA documentation.
- [TennCare (Tennessee Medicaid) ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/tenncare-tennessee-medicaid): Coverage through age 21 via EPSDT with no annual benefit limit, prior auth and medical necessity, TN LBA licensure, MCO administration.
- [Ohio Medicaid ABA guide](https://carelu.com/payers/ohio-medicaid): Adaptive behavior services under Ohio Administrative Code 5160-34-02 — prior auth on all ABA, DSM-5-TR diagnosis, 6-month medical-necessity reviews.
- [Free verification-call checklist (PDF)](https://carelu.com/downloads/aba-verification-call-checklist.pdf): Every question to ask on an ABA benefits-verification call.

## Platform integrations

- [Integrations directory](https://carelu.com/integrations): The platforms Carelu connects to — practice management, EHRs, CRMs, and webhooks.

- [Carelu + Aloha ABA integration](https://carelu.com/integrations/aloha-aba): Carelu answers and admits families 24/7, then delivers complete records into your practice-management system.
- [Carelu + CentralReach integration](https://carelu.com/integrations/centralreach): Carelu connects with CentralReach — intake completed conversationally, records delivered into the EHR with no re-keying.
- [Carelu + Rethink integration](https://carelu.com/integrations/rethink-behavioral-health): Carelu fills the Rethink platform: instant response, verification, documents, and complete records delivered in.
- [Carelu + Chorus integration](https://carelu.com/integrations/chorus): Carelu completes intake and captures clean insurance data, feeding Chorus's revenue-cycle platform (eligibility, remits, claims) verified records from day one.
- [Carelu vs. a CRM](https://carelu.com/carelu-vs-crm): Why a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Monday, ClickUp) is software your team operates, while Carelu is a care enablement platform that does ABA intake for you — and integrates with your CRM so you never leave it, or serves as your system of record.
- [Carelu vs. Salesforce](https://carelu.com/carelu-vs-salesforce): Salesforce for ABA intake vs. Carelu — combine (Carelu works inside Salesforce) or use Carelu as your CRM.
- [Carelu vs. HubSpot](https://carelu.com/carelu-vs-hubspot): HubSpot vs. Carelu for ABA intake — integrate or replace.
- [Carelu vs. Zoho](https://carelu.com/carelu-vs-zoho): Zoho CRM vs. Carelu for ABA intake — integrate or replace.
- [Carelu vs. monday.com](https://carelu.com/carelu-vs-monday): monday.com vs. Carelu for ABA intake — integrate or replace.
- [Carelu vs. ClickUp](https://carelu.com/carelu-vs-clickup): ClickUp vs. Carelu for ABA intake — integrate or replace.

## Compliance & risk

- [Zapier & Make are not HIPAA compliant](https://carelu.com/zapier-make-hipaa-risk): Neither Zapier nor Make signs a Business Associate Agreement or supports PHI, so routing ABA intake data through them can put a provider in HIPAA violation. Covers the dangers, HIPAA penalty tiers, and the front-office risks. General info, not legal advice.
- [The biggest ABA front-office risks](https://carelu.com/aba-front-office-risks): The compliance, revenue, and clinical risks that live in the front office — PHI/BAA handling, claim denials from bad intake data, prior-authorization gaps, assessment and documentation errors, unverified eligibility, breach exposure, and audit/recoupment risk.

## Common questions

- **How do I stop losing ABA families to slow intake?** Respond to every inquiry the moment it arrives — across every channel, day and night — and complete intake before a competitor does. Carelu automates that first response and the full intake so no family waits.
- **What is ABA waitlist management?** Keeping prospective families engaged, informed, and moving from inquiry to first appointment instead of going cold on a waitlist. Carelu keeps every family warm with instant response and automated follow-up.
- **How does an AI intake agent work for ABA?** It answers calls, chats, forms, and texts; collects the family's information and documents; verifies insurance eligibility; schedules the first appointment; and routes anything needing a human to your team — with a full record on every family.
- **Is Carelu HIPAA compliant?** Yes — HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and Carelu signs a BAA with every provider.
